BSW Description
This parameter specifies that this LPdu is reconfigurable using FrIf_ReconfigLPdu. This means that
this LPdu can be assigned to a different FrameTriggering at runtime. However, this reconfiguration
is limited by hardware constraints. The direction of the LPdu cannot be reconfigured.
